plain_english_summary: Deterministic digital-ink transport codec for structured pen-stream workflows across multiple runtimes.
commercial_wedge: Cross-runtime parity and >5× compression for structured ink streams. Multi-runtime bindings (Python, Rust, WASM, Swift, C#). Bounded real-public surface now includes UJI Pen Characters at 1.6111x exact roundtrip.
technical_wedge: Multi-runtime .zpink codec with 8-direction Freeman chain-code stroke tokenisation packed as 4-bit nibbles, structured-tier compression >5× vs raw float32. Cross-runtime parity verified locally. A bounded phase-03 public-benchmark artifact measures UJI Pen Characters at 1.6111x with exact roundtrip.
ideal_first_buyer: Stylus/annotation runtime team or cross-platform pen-input infrastructure team
deployment_model: SDK — Python package with repo-local Rust/WASM/Swift/C# bindings
not_claimed: Any claim that the UJI Pen Characters row closes release readiness or hard-corpus authority
family_position: Secondary product candidate in the Zer0pa deterministic encoding family. Not the lead commercial front door.
